diagnosis.what_happened: Headings defaulted to left alignment due to stripped '<w:jc>' tag, and raw Markdown asterisks were baked into OpenXML text runs instead of being converted to native italic/bold.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Stripping explicit right alignment caused Word to default to left. Missing inline tokenization resulted in literal asterisks in docx text runs.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Headings must have explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>'. Inline Markdown must be parsed into native '<w:i/>' and '<w:b/>' Word runs.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Persian academic formatting requires explicit RTL alignment. Raw markdown syntax is unacceptable in final Word deliverables.

desired_behavior: Mandatory: 1) Inject explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>' for all Persian headings. 2) Tokenize inline Markdown into OpenXML '<w:i/>' / '<w:b/>' runs with zero raw asterisks in '<w:t>'.
generalization: Ensure all RTL generated documents have explicit structural alignment and avoid raw Markdown artifacts.

evidence.observed_value: Defective formatting and raw markdown in output
